basic_details.job_title: NHM Chandigarh Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 7 Dental Assistant, Pharmacist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Health Mission Chandigarh (NHM Chandigarh) has announced 7 contract vacancies for Dental Assistant (NOHP), Dispenser Ayurvedic (AYUSH), and Pharmacist (NUHM) posts. Eligible applicants must submit their offline applications by hand or post to the O/o Mission Director, National Health Mission, 4th Floor, Administrative Block, Sector-16, U.T, Chandigarh on or before 23 October 2026. Qualifications and eligibility requirements vary by post. The notified pay is Rs. 23,445 for Dental Assistant (NOHP), Rs. 24,574 for Dispenser Ayurvedic (AYUSH), and Rs. 26,896 for Pharmacist (NUHM). qualification.details: Detailed Eligibility Requirements: | Dental Assistant (NOHP): 10+2 with science subjects (Physics, Chemistry & Biology) from a recognized board (full time course) and having Dental Chair side Assistant Diploma / 3-5 years of experience in Dental College/Dental Clinic. Dispenser Ayurvedic (AYUSH): Degree in Ayurvedic Pharmacy or Diploma in Ayurvedic Pharmacy Course duration of which should not be less than two years from any recognized University/institutions. Must be registered with respective State Government Ayurvedic regulatory Boards or Councils. Must have two years experience in the field of Ayurvedic Pharmacist/Dispenser (Ayurvedic) from any recognized Ayurvedic Dispensary or Hospital or Pharmacy or wellness centres. Pharmacist (NUHM): D-Pharma or Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy from a recognized University with One year Diploma in Computer Applications. Must be registered as Pharmacist with U.T., Chandigarh Pharmacy Council.

selection_process: The selection of candidates will be based on a written test carrying a total of 100 marks.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Desirous candidates having the requisite qualifications shall submit their Bio-data on the Application Format available on the official website along with self-attested photocopies of certificates and testimonials from matriculation onwards and one recent attested passport-size photograph. Applications must be submitted to the O/o Mission Director, National Health Mission, 4th Floor, Administrative Block, Govt. Multi Speciality Hospital, Sector-16, Chd.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in NHM Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 7 contract vacancies have been announced under advertisement number NHM-UT/15/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications for NHM Chandigarh posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23 October 2026 up to 1:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for NHM Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for the advertised categories is up to 60 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Dental Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, and Biology) from a recognized board along with a Dental Chair side Assistant Diploma or 3-5 years of experience in a Dental College/Dental Clinic.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Pharmacist (NUHM) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated amount is Rs. 26,896 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for NHM Chandigarh posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their Bio-data on the prescribed Application Format along with self-attested photocopies of certificates to the O/o Mission Director, National Health Mission, 4th Floor, Administrative Block, Govt. Multi Speciality Hospital, Sector-16, Chd.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NHM Chandigarh recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written test carrying 100 marks.

faq.question: Q9. When will the list of eligible candidates and written test details be published?
faq.answer: The list of eligible candidates and details regarding the written test will be displayed on the official website on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These posts are to be filled on a contract basis initially up to 31 March 2027, but are extendable depending upon performance, conduct, and the duration of the project.
